baseline_models.focus_anchor: The achieved knowing in علمت, its inward subject نفس, and the coordinated causatives قدمت وأخرت.
baseline_models.mechanism: The perfect verb presents disclosure as accomplished. The two causatives partition agency into what the self deliberately put into precedence and what it held into delay, making its ordering decisions, not only isolated acts, the object of knowledge.

activation_trace.role: A thing becoming clear supplies the transition from unexamined activity to achieved self-disclosure.
Inner thought and hidden intent locate the disclosed material inside the acting self.
Beforeward advance and precedence make presenting an act a decision about priority.
Postponement to a later time makes withheld timing as legible as forward action.

changed_reading.before: A soul remembers the deeds it did earlier and later.
changed_reading.after: A soul has its own priority structure disclosed: what it pushed into precedence and what it held in delay both become fully knowable.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The mark-image in علم, the foot and forepart images in قدم, and the posterior image in أخر.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse can be spatialized as a complete trail. The self recognizes its very identity through marks extending from the leading edge it set before itself to the wake it left at the rear; knowledge is track-reading rather than bare recollection.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing mark that points onward turns knowing into reading an evidentiary trace.
The stepping foot supplies the concrete production of a track.
The forepart and leading edge define the forward side of the self's trail.
The rear or posterior part supplies the wake against which the leading edge is read.
The very thing itself makes the full front-to-rear trace disclose identity rather than an external itinerary.

changed_reading.before: The verse inventories two temporal classes of deeds.
changed_reading.after: The verse lets the self read its whole evidentiary trail, from the leading marks it placed ahead to the wake remaining behind.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The precedent-standing branch of قدم and the later-or-other branch of أخر around the living نفس.
baseline_models.mechanism: The causatives divide effects around the self's own passage: some deeds, claims, or merits are dispatched before it, while other consequences are made to remain later than it. Knowledge gathers both sides of a biographical relay.

activation_trace.role: Becoming clear gathers temporally separated effects into one act of recognition.
The living soul-self supplies the finite life around which before-going and after-remaining effects are arranged.
Precedent merit and standing supply what has already gone ahead on the self's behalf.
What is later or other than the first supplies consequences that remain after the initial actor or act.

changed_reading.before: The self learns what it performed before and afterward.
changed_reading.after: The self confronts a temporal relay of agency: deposits that reached the reckoning before it and effects it caused to remain after it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The four preceding scenes repeatedly remove containment: a boundary splits, ordered lights scatter, abundance bursts out, and concealed graves are turned over. The focus then renders knowing as the inward equivalent of this material exhumation, with what was ahead or behind forced onto one exposed surface.

activation_trace.role: A thing becoming clear names the epistemic result of the surrounding exposure sequence.
Hidden inward thought gives the cosmic breaches an internal archive to expose.
Forward precedence supplies one layer of the archive now laid open.
The rear or posterior supplies the formerly hidden reverse layer brought into view.
Opening and splitting supply the first breached boundary in the exposure mechanism.
Casting contents in a dispersed state removes their prior arrangement and concealment.
A sudden abundant thrust outward makes disclosure forceful rather than voluntary recall.
Obscurity and low concealment provide the buried state from which the record emerges.
Turning soil and uncovering what is buried directly models the self's formerly covered contents becoming evidence.

structural_cues: The repeated إذا clauses in 82:1-4 suspend four disruptions until the focus clause in 82:5 supplies their human result.
The sequence moves from the upper boundary through dispersed lights and waters to graves, progressively approaching concealed personal material.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies splitting, dispersal, bursting, burial, and exhumation; I supply the arrow from material decontainment to cognitive disclosure. A live alternative is that the scenes only date an otherwise independent act of reckoning.

changed_reading.before: The soul introspectively recalls its record at the appointed time.
changed_reading.after: The soul knows because every layer that kept its record ordered, distant, or buried has been overturned and made evidentially present.

context_deltas.mechanism: Nurture and generosity create an interval in which consequences are not immediately collected. Glittering deception and denial misread that interval as cancellation, while the accounting branch of دين converts قدمت وأخرت into entries already posted and entries merely deferred to maturity.

activation_trace.role: Precedent merit or standing supplies what is already posted ahead in the account.
Deferral to a later time distinguishes postponed settlement from erased consequence.
Deception by what shines but does not hold supplies the false appearance that delay means safety.
Repair, nurture, and completion supply the sustained interval that can be misconstrued as impunity.
Honored generosity supplies the real quality that deception converts into a false inference.
Contradiction of truth supplies the maintained refusal to recognize the pending settlement.
Accounting and recompense make the deferred side of the focus pair a live liability rather than an absence.

structural_cues: The direct rebuke of 82:6 immediately follows the third-person disclosure in 82:5, turning the known record back into a present question about misperception.
The denial named in 82:9 is denial of the same دين later repeated as the event of settlement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nurture, generosity, deceptive shine, denial, accounting, and deferral; I infer that gracious delay is the misleading interval. A live alternative is that the deception concerns status before the Lord without any temporal-account mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The soul learns which deeds occurred early and which occurred late.
changed_reading.after: The soul discovers that generosity postponed collection without deleting the account: what seemed safely delayed had continued toward settlement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The measured, completed, balanced, imaged, willed, and layered body supplies a fabrication grammar. Against it, advancing and deferring are not only entries attributed to a pre-existing self; they are ordering operations whose accumulated layers compose the self that finally knows.

activation_trace.role: The very thing itself makes the product of accumulated ordering the self's own identity.
Intentional turning toward a thing supplies selected material for the self's composition.
Deferral supplies negative ordering, where what is withheld also affects the resulting form.
Measuring and proportioning provide the fabrication rule against which choices become formative.
Intrinsic straightness and completion supply the coherence of the composed result.
One load balancing another supplies a model for how advanced and deferred choices distribute weight.
Image and fashioned form make the eventual self a configuration rather than a loose deed list.
Will attached to a thing supplies selection within the composition sequence.
Inserting one thing into another supplies the layered assembly mechanism.

structural_cues: The tightly chained second-person verbs of 82:7-8 describe one addressee as measured, balanced, imaged, and composed.
That passive formation follows a focus ayah in which the نفس is the grammatical subject of its own advancing and delaying.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bodily measuring, balancing, imaging, willing, and composition; I map that fabrication sequence onto the cumulative effect of human prioritizing. A live alternative is that the context contrasts divine formation with creaturely action rather than analogizing them.

changed_reading.before: A fixed self receives information about its prior choices.
changed_reading.after: The self recognizes the form those choices built: every advancement and postponement was also an operation in its own composition.

context_deltas.mechanism: Guarding stabilizes acts, writing joins them into an inscription with consequence, and a second knowing subject knows what people do. The soul's knowledge therefore becomes convergence between inward recognition and a reliable external trace, not memory controlling its own evidence.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing mark that guides makes the soul's knowing responsive to evidence.
Inner thought and intent provide the private side of the later evidentiary convergence.
Precedence orders the externally retained acts rather than leaving them as an unstructured mass.
Later and remaining material extends the inscription beyond immediately completed action.
Watchful preservation prevents acts from disappearing before disclosure.
Honored nobility supplies the recorders' reliability within the evidence mechanism.
Joining letters into a written object turns dispersed acts into a readable record.
An inscription that entails judgment gives the preserved record operative force.
A second instance of things becoming clear supplies knowledge independent of the focus soul's report.
The production of an act identifies what the guardians preserve and the soul later recognizes.

structural_cues: The relative sequence 82:10-12 moves from watchers to writers to their knowing, progressively specifying an external record system.
The ما-object in يعلمون ما تفعلون echoes ما قدمت وأخرت while changing the knower from one soul to plural observers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies preservation, honorable recorders, consequential inscription, and their knowledge of acts; I infer a convergence between that record and the soul's knowledge. A live alternative is that the two knowings remain parallel without any encounter.

changed_reading.before: The soul alone reconstructs its own past.
changed_reading.after: The soul's inward recognition meets a preserved, consequential inscription whose evidence was maintained by knowers outside it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Truthful action and boundary-breaking action lead into paired conditions described as being inside ease or blaze, followed by encounter with heat and negated absence. This recasts what the soul advanced and delayed as the construction of a condition it must inhabit, not merely items on a ledger.

activation_trace.role: The self in its whole identity is the inhabitant produced by the accumulated action pattern.
Intentional movement toward a thing supplies the directional entry into a resulting condition.
What remains later supplies persistence beyond the moment of choosing.
Truth that carries word and action through supplies one coherent trajectory.
A fitting place and good dwelling make one consequence explicitly habitable.
Deviation from truth and tearing a cover supply the contrary action trajectory.
Blazing fire and severe heat make the contrary consequence an encompassing condition.
Meeting fire and its heat turns classification into experienced contact.
Concealment from sight, explicitly negated in the verse, supplies the impossibility of leaving that condition.

structural_cues: The balanced clauses of 82:13-14 place each named group inside its condition with repeated لفي.
The following contact verb and negated absence convert static classification into continued occupancy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies truthful or transgressive trajectories, dwelling, heat, contact, and non-absence; I infer that accumulated action becomes lived environment. A live alternative is a simpler reward-and-punishment sequence with no claim that deeds configure the habitat.

changed_reading.before: The soul sees deeds as past objects awaiting reward or punishment.
changed_reading.after: The soul sees what its ordering of action has become around it: a persistent condition into which it has already been moving.

context_deltas.mechanism: Denial and hiddenness characterize the present, while the repeated question about what can convey knowledge of the Day withholds conceptual mastery. The perfect علمت at the focus is therefore not ordinary information but the knowledge-state generated when the severe event and its account become present.

activation_trace.role: A thing becoming clear supplies the achieved endpoint that the later questions presently withhold.
Opposition to truth supplies the pre-event epistemic condition reversed by the focus perfect.
Accounting and recompense specify the event whose arrival resolves denied knowledge.
The day's occurrence and severity make time itself the forcing condition of disclosure.
Being hidden from sight, negated in context, supplies the concealment that can no longer be maintained.
Knowledge in the first rhetorical question marks the present limit of explanation.
Repeated knowledge intensifies the gap between being told about the Day and undergoing its disclosure.

structural_cues: The near-identical questions in 82:17 and 82:18 delay definition, then 82:19 answers by describing the Day's loss of creaturely control.
Against those present rhetorical questions, 82:5 uses a perfect verb inside the future event sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denial, concealment, repeated questions about knowledge, a severe day, and accounting; I infer that occurrence, not explanation, causes the focus knowledge. A live alternative is that the questions only magnify the Day while علمت remains ordinary recollection.

changed_reading.before: The soul is informed about its deeds on a future date.
changed_reading.after: The event itself produces a kind of knowing unavailable in advance: denied and hidden relations become immediately clear when the Day is undergone.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final day denies one self possession or disposal of any thing for another self and reserves authority to God. The indefinite singular نفس in the focus consequently becomes a non-substitutable center of attribution: neither its advanced deposits nor its deferred liabilities can be transferred, offset, or managed by another self.

activation_trace.role: The very thing itself makes each focus subject an irreducible identity rather than an interchangeable unit.
Precedent standing supplies what has gone ahead specifically for that self.
Deferred material supplies obligations that remain attached despite their later settlement.
A knowable, reportable thing makes the denial of transfer maximally comprehensive.
Possession and power of disposal supply the agency explicitly denied between selves.
The repeated self-as-very-identity keeps actor and beneficiary distinct and blocks substitution.
Authority and its holder relocate final control away from every creaturely self.
The worshipped deity identifies the sole terminus of the authority denied to selves.

structural_cues: The same noun نفس appears once as the indefinite knower in 82:5 and twice in the reciprocal-looking relation of 82:19.
The universal object شيئا and the following exclusive authority clause close every apparent route of substitution.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denied possession between selves, an unrestricted thing, and exclusive divine authority; I infer non-transferability of the focus record. A live alternative is that 82:19 asserts only helplessness at the event, without specifying how records remain attributed.

changed_reading.before: Each soul knows a personal list, though another agent might still alter its practical outcome.
changed_reading.after: Knowing includes recognition of non-transferable attribution: no other self can take over, offset, or dispose of what this self advanced or deferred.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines a non-dominant split mapping of the sky root with the bodily-cleft branch of علم. It remains anchored in the focus root's explicit mark and cleft inventories and in the context's explicit splitting branch. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for disclosure, not as the lexical meaning of sky or knowing.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The mark and visible-cleft branches of علم beside the front-edge verb قدمت.

activation_trace.role: A visible distinguishing mark makes knowledge readable from a surface.
A visible upper cleft supplies the strange bodily image of disclosure as a scar or opening.
The forepart and leading edge give the disclosed mark an oriented surface.
The non-dominant image of a visible brand that makes something known turns the upper scene into a marked surface.
Opening and splitting actualize that marked surface as a readable rupture.

changed_reading.before: Knowing is an entirely interior mental event.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the self and the split upper world become scarred surfaces whose openings make previously hidden orientation readable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the leeway, distance, and delay branch of نفس rather than its ordinary soul branch. It remains anchored by that exact focus inventory, the adjacent advance-delay pair, and the final repetition of نفس within a bounded Day. Downstream prose should keep it as a structural resonance about a life's temporal room, not replace the grammatical subject 'soul' with 'interval.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: نفس between the achieved knowing and the opposed temporal operations قدمت وأخرت.

activation_trace.role: Leeway, distance, and delay make the self resonate as the temporal room across which choices are distributed.
Beforeward advance stretches agency toward the front of that interval.
Deferral stretches agency toward the interval's later edge.
A bounded duration supplies the terminal frame in which prior leeway closes.
Repeated leeway or distance makes the denied relation between selves also a collapse of borrowed room.
Denied possession prevents one self from extending another's temporal room.

changed_reading.before: A soul learns how it used time.
changed_reading.after: A life appears as borrowed temporal room: it projects some agency forward, holds some back, and finally knows the pattern when that room can no longer be extended by another self.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the adze homonym under قدم and joins it to measuring, assembly, and fire-straightening branches across the context. It remains anchored in a supplied focus branch and the explicit creation-composition and fire sequence. Downstream prose should label it a cross-material analogy, not claim that قدمت lexically means carving here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The adze branch of قدمت acting on نفس as the very thing itself.

activation_trace.role: The adze used for carving supplies a subtractive image for choices cutting a durable form.
The very thing itself makes the material being formed the self rather than an external artifact.
Measurement and proportion constrain the otherwise free carving analogy.
Inserting one thing into another adds an assembly process alongside carving.
Kindling heat and straightening a thing by fire supply a final setting or testing of the composed form.

changed_reading.before: The record consists of detachable acts owned by a stable self.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, advancing choices carve and assemble the self, and the later fire scene exposes the set of the resulting form.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant ر ب و mapping under رب, a gift-seeking-recompense branch under كرم, and the financial-debt branch of دين. The packet explicitly supplies every branch and the focus explicitly opposes precedence to deferral, so the mechanism is traceable. Downstream prose must qualify it as a formal economic echo only, never as a lexical or theological equation of the Lord's generosity with usury.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The precedent-standing and postponement branches of قدمت وأخرت.

activation_trace.role: Prior merit or standing supplies value already placed forward.
Deferred settlement supplies the time over which value remains unresolved.
The non-dominant image of increase in a transaction supplies the risky idea of consequences growing across delay.
A gift that seeks recompense introduces an exchange expectation into the generosity scene.
Financial debt supplies the delayed obligation that the other economic images make visible.

changed_reading.before: Advanced and delayed deeds remain static until a later review.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they behave like unsettled placements in a moral economy whose significance can grow during the very delay mistaken for release.

strongest_changes: The pre-focus ruptures turn knowing from private recall into forced exhumation of every concealed layer.
The guardians and consequential writing make self-knowledge converge with an independently preserved record.
The repeated questions about knowing the Day make occurrence itself, rather than prior explanation, the cause of disclosure.
The final denial of ownership between selves makes the advanced and deferred record non-transferable.
summary.what_was_special: The same compact focus supports several coexisting mechanics without collapse: temporal prioritizing, front-to-rear trace reading, legacy relay, material exhumation, account maturity, self-composition, external inscription, inhabited consequence, and event-generated knowledge. Split mappings also opened contained but live mark, interval, carving, and compounding analogies.
remaining_uncertainties: The front-and-rear trail may be a productive branch analogy rather than a strong semantic pressure in the surface construction.
The creation sequence may analogize ethical self-composition, or it may function primarily as a contrast between divine formation and human response.
The habitat model depends on carrying the paired locatives back into the focus rather than reading them only as later destinations.
Non-dominant split-root and homonym outliers have low lexical force even where their cross-verse mechanisms remain visible.
